title: Verify that an Administrator can complete the full newsletter lifecycle from Draft through Publish and receive a Liferay success toast at each step
description: Functional-High: full admin lifecycle E2E. Covers AC-7, AC-8, AC-9, AC-10.

steps.action: Log in as Administrator, navigate to Newsletter Management
Create newsletter with Title EN/AR, fill mandatory fields, click Save as Draft
steps.expected: Draft saved; status = Draft; Liferay generic success toast shown (EN+AR)

steps.action: Click Submit for Review
steps.expected: Status changes to Pending Review; success toast shown (EN+AR)

steps.action: Click Approve
steps.expected: Status changes to Approved; success toast shown (EN+AR)

steps.action: Click Publish Immediately
steps.expected: Status changes to Published; newsletter sent by email to all currently Active subscribers only; every sent email includes a clear Unsubscribe link at the bottom; success toast shown (EN+AR)

title: Verify that Content (EN) accepts valid rich-text/HTML content

steps.action: Enter formatted rich text (heading + paragraph + bullet list) into Content (EN)
Click Save as Draft
steps.expected: Draft saved successfully; formatting preserved on reload

title: Verify that saving a newsletter with empty Content (EN) is rejected

steps.action: Leave Content (EN) empty; fill remaining mandatory fields
Click Save as Draft
steps.expected: Validation error "Content (EN) is required." displayed; draft not saved

title: Verify that malformed/invalid HTML in Content (EN) is rejected or sanitized
description: Functional-Low validity check for FLD-8 (Valid HTML constraint).

steps.action: Paste unclosed div and script tag markup into the Content (EN) source view
Click Save as Draft
steps.expected: System either rejects the save with an invalid-HTML validation error, or sanitizes the input by stripping the unclosed tag and script element before storing; stored content contains no executable script tag

title: Verify that Content (AR) accepts valid rich-text/HTML content

steps.action: Enter formatted Arabic rich text (heading + paragraph) into Content (AR)
Click Save as Draft
steps.expected: Draft saved successfully; formatting preserved on reload

title: Verify that saving a newsletter with empty Content (AR) is rejected

steps.action: Leave Content (AR) empty; fill remaining mandatory fields
Click Save as Draft
steps.expected: Validation error "Content (AR) is required." displayed; draft not saved

title: Verify that scheduling with a Publish Date in the past is rejected

steps.action: Enter yesterday's date at 09:00 in Publish Date
Click Schedule
steps.expected: Validation error "Scheduled send date must be a future date and time." displayed; schedule action blocked

title: Verify that clicking Approve on a Pending Review newsletter moves it to Approved status

steps.action: Open a newsletter with status Pending Review
Click Approve
steps.expected: Status changes to Approved; success toast shown (EN+AR)

title: Verify that clicking Reject on a Pending Review newsletter returns it to Draft/Rejected without sending

steps.action: Open a newsletter with status Pending Review
Click Reject
steps.expected: Status changes to Rejected/Draft (per workflow config); no email is sent to subscribers; success toast confirming the rejection action shown (EN+AR)

title: Verify that an Administrator can access and perform all Newsletter Management actions

steps.action: Log in as Administrator
Navigate to Newsletter Management
Attempt Create, Approve, Publish, Schedule, Archive actions
steps.expected: All actions available: Create, Approve, Publish, Schedule, Archive complete successfully

title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can view and manage newsletters where permitted, but cannot access Administrator-only actions

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor
Navigate to Newsletter Management
Attempt to view/edit a newsletter within permitted scope
Attempt an Administrator-only action outside permitted scope
steps.expected: Access Denied message "Access Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action." displayed

title: Verify that a Site Content Author can view and update newsletter content but cannot publish directly

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Author
Open a Draft newsletter and edit content
Attempt to click Publish Immediately
steps.expected: Access Denied message displayed; newsletter remains unpublished

title: Verify that a Public Visitor cannot access the Newsletter Management CMS module

steps.action: As an unauthenticated Public Visitor, attempt to navigate directly to the Newsletter Management CMS URL
steps.expected: Access is denied; visitor is redirected to login or shown "Access Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action."

title: Verify that a Site Content Editor is denied access to Administrator-only subscriber-list management

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor
Attempt to navigate to the subscriber list management screen
steps.expected: Access Denied message "Access Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action." displayed

title: Verify that a Site Content Author is denied access to the Approve/Reject action

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Author
Open a Pending Review newsletter
Attempt to click Approve
steps.expected: Approve control is not available or returns Access Denied message
